description: Fix critical server-side auth and security issues: (1) First deployment cannot login because auth.json doesn't exist and login throws 500. Add auto-initialization with default password 'admin123'. (2) Cookie parsing uses manual implementation instead of h3's getCookie. (3) File upload has no size limit or type validation. (4) Token storage is in-memory only, lost on restart. (5) revokeToken parameter type issue in logout.
steps: In server/utils/auth.ts - modify loadAuth() to auto-initialize auth.json with hashed 'admin123' password when the file doesn't exist. Use hashPassword('admin123') and saveAuth() to persist it. This way first deployment can login with admin123.
In server/utils/auth.ts - replace the manual parseCookies function and custom getHeader in requireAuth() with h3's getCookie(event, 'wh-admin-token'). Import getCookie from 'h3'.

In server/utils/auth.ts - persist tokens to app/data/tokens.json instead of in-memory Map. Add loadTokens() and saveTokens() functions. The token store format should be Record<string, number> (hashed token -> expiry). Load tokens from file on first access, save after register/revoke/validate(expired). Clean expired tokens on load.

In server/api/admin/upload.post.ts - add file size validation (max 5MB = 5 * 1024 * 1024 bytes). Add MIME type validation allowing only: image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, image/webp, image/svg+xml. Return 400 error with descriptive message if validation fails.
In server/api/admin/logout.post.ts - add null check for token before calling revokeToken. The getCookie may return undefined, so guard with: if (token) { revokeToken(token) }
acceptance_criteria: When auth.json does not exist, loadAuth() creates it with the hash of 'admin123' and returns valid auth data
requireAuth uses h3's getCookie instead of manual cookie parsing
Tokens are persisted to app/data/tokens.json and survive server restart
Upload rejects files larger than 5MB with 400 error
Upload rejects non-image MIME types with 400 error
Logout handles undefined token without throwing
verification: Run npm run build from /projects/sandbox/WinterHome and confirm no TypeScript/build errors
